title: 模拟行走机器人 II
summary: 机器人沿宽高矩形边界逆时针行走，支持前进若干步并查询位置和朝向。
insight: 把边界展开为长度 2(width+height)-4 的循环进度。步数取模更新进度，再按其落在哪条边映射坐标与移动方向；初始原点方向是东，完成整圈回原点方向是南。
pitfalls: 角点方向是到达该点时的移动方向
正步数整圈后原点方向为南

solutions.title: 周长进度映射
solutions.idea: 用单个循环坐标替代逐步模拟。
steps: getPos/getDir 按四段 [东边、北边、西边、南边] 映射，progress=0 特判初始东或移动后南

code.java: class Robot { int width,height,perimeter,progress;boolean moved;public Robot(int width,int height){this.width=width;this.height=height;perimeter=2*(width+height)-4;}public void step(int num){progress=(progress+num%perimeter)%perimeter;moved=true;}public int[] getPos(){int east=width-1,north=east+height-1,west=north+width-1;if(progress<=east)return new int[]{progress,0};if(progress<=north)return new int[]{width-1,progress-east};if(progress<=west)return new int[]{width-1-(progress-north),height-1};return new int[]{0,height-1-(progress-west)};}public String getDir(){int east=width-1,north=east+height-1,west=north+width-1;if(progress==0)return moved?"South":"East";if(progress<=east)return "East";if(progress<=north)return "North";if(progress<=west)return "West";return "South";} }
code.kotlin: class Robot(private val width:Int,private val height:Int){private val perimeter=2*(width+height)-4;private var progress=0;private var moved=false;fun step(num:Int){progress=(progress+num%perimeter)%perimeter;moved=true}fun getPos():IntArray{val east=width-1;val north=east+height-1;val west=north+width-1;return when{progress<=east->intArrayOf(progress,0);progress<=north->intArrayOf(width-1,progress-east);progress<=west->intArrayOf(width-1-(progress-north),height-1);else->intArrayOf(0,height-1-(progress-west))}}fun getDir():String{val east=width-1;val north=east+height-1;val west=north+width-1;return when{progress==0->if(moved)"South" else "East";progress<=east->"East";progress<=north->"North";progress<=west->"West";else->"South"}}}
code.cpp: class Robot { int width,height,perimeter,progress=0;bool moved=false;public: Robot(int width,int height):width(width),height(height),perimeter(2*(width+height)-4){}void step(int num){progress=(progress+num%perimeter)%perimeter;moved=true;}vector<int> getPos(){int east=width-1,north=east+height-1,west=north+width-1;if(progress<=east)return{progress,0};if(progress<=north)return{width-1,progress-east};if(progress<=west)return{width-1-(progress-north),height-1};return{0,height-1-(progress-west)};}string getDir(){int east=width-1,north=east+height-1,west=north+width-1;if(!progress)return moved?"South":"East";if(progress<=east)return"East";if(progress<=north)return"North";if(progress<=west)return"West";return"South";} };
